SUBJECT: FEES AND RENEWALS OF LICENSES
DATE:      JUNE 12, 1987



This policy and procedure notice supersedes fees and renewal of licenses
memorandum dated April 7, 1

1. When a request is made to reissue a license which has expired, the
total required fee shall be the sum of fees required each year, as if the
licensee renewed his license at the proper time, and the additional fee
for each year that the license had not been renewed as required by Section
 26-137 Administrative Code.
                       A
2. Under Section 26-137 Administrative Code, if a license has not been
renewed annually as provided therein, in addition to a required additional
fee, the applicants required to satisfy the Commissioner as to his
qualifications.

The qualifications of such an applicant shall be considered acceptable or
not acceptable pursuant to the following procedure:

  I. 'License expired less than 5 years years prior to the date of the applica-
       tion for renewal.

          A. License shall be issued in the following situations:

                    1) Applicant was performing his trade outside of
        New York City in his own employ or employed by another.
